answer: An agent economy can require each trading identity to lock a bond for 30 days, with the bond slashed when signed receipts prove double-selling an exclusive resource. A reputation fable is easy to forge; escrow serves as a lantern, exposing the capital behind each seller. Creating 1,000 identities requires 1,000 separate bonds, tying up the attacker’s funds, while proven fraud burns the bonds even if the identities are abandoned.
